description:
# Research software and reproducibility evidence, version 1.0.0

DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23447567 (registered on publication of the Zenodo record).
Source repository: https://github.com/T0Q0R/secondhand-valuation-research
Immutable source commit: 89ad56e3d217b5d5f94f822c86801b1abc1c9b2f
Publication date of this archival version: 2026-10-18.

## Scope

This is a screened software-and-small-evidence archive, not a complete raw-data/model archive or a journal publication. It contains project software, software/protocol documentation, aggregate tables and computational receipts. The full repository retains historical scientific context. No acceptance, real-seller validation, cross-machine numerical equivalence, or universal method superiority is implied.

## Main evidence

- `notes/rpl-five-factorial-v1/RESULTS.zh.md`: the completed 90-cell RPL by five task-adapted acquisition-family crossing (3 sources x 3 common fitting seeds x 2 RPL weights x 5 families), 10% capacity and gap 0.5. All 45 paired inflation comparisons decrease, while other objectives and all 18 nonconverged cells/batches remain. This is retrospective three-seed evidence.
- `notes/rpl-five-factorial-v1/factorial-90-cells.csv`, `factorial-45-paired-effects.csv`, `factorial-15-comparisons.csv` and `factorial-interactions-vs-aco.csv`: full cells, seed pairs, ranges and interaction contrasts.
- `notes/rpl-five-factorial-v1/cell-receipts.json.gz`: 90 aggregate computational receipts; no listing-level outcomes or trained weights.
- `notes/external-reproduction-synthetic-v1/numerical-difference-table-v1/`: six existing synthetic/seed13 external-machine comparisons and 36 metric differences under the original tolerances. Strict numerical reproduction failed and remains failed.
- `experiments/run_rpl_five_factorial_v3.py`: final crossing runner, with v1/v2 preserved for failure provenance. Model/policy fits are reused; no new fitting. V3 checks exact original source training IDs and an immutable manuscript startup snapshot, allowing independent manuscript editing.
- `notes/rpl-five-factorial-v1/RECOVERY.zh.md`: preserved run failures and migration boundaries.
- `audit-protocol/`, `reproduction/`, `REPRODUCING.md`, and `data/README.md`: software interfaces, reproduction scope and original input acquisition routes.

## Rights and exclusions

The repository MIT license applies to project-authored software and its software documentation, as specified in LICENSE_SCOPE.md. Third-party code retains upstream licenses and notices. Aggregate results are provided as scientific evidence; this record does not extend the MIT grant to source datasets, manuscript text, scientific figures, or third-party publications. No new blanket data/content license is asserted.

The package excludes all manuscript TeX/BibTeX, paper/figure/image files, third-party paper/full-text literature collections, historical ZIP bundles, listing-level compressed outcomes, binary arrays, model weights and input datasets. The inventory lists included and excluded paths and included-file SHA256 hashes. Input sources remain under provider rights and access rules. The package is a subset of the source commit; use the repository for excluded scientific context.

## Reproduction limits

Some historical frozen runners require external datasets, checkpoint artifacts or original manuscript versions not included here. The fresh-training reproduction contract and data instructions identify those dependencies. A public archive is separate from computational audit completeness and external numerical reproduction. The new 90 cells have independent outcome-algebra checks, not the full four-stage fit/statistical audit of the earlier 1206-cell core.
